notes: The PDF pages are low-resolution pictures with no readable part callouts for the main steps, so piece-to-step placement is inferred from the pictures and the inventory counts. Every inventory piece is used exactly once, but some exact attachment pairs (especially body steps 8-15) are best guesses.
Ports are left null on most joined edges because the exact stud/anti-stud used is not identifiable from the pictures.

Two legs are built differently (pages 11-12 and 13-14). They are modelled as separate parts la* and lb*, not as a repeat. Leg A: 1x1 brick, one slope 1x2, grey and orange slopes. Leg B: two slope 1x2, grey and orange slopes. Each leg sits on a black inverted slope foot and has a ball that snaps into a ball-socket plate under the body (b2 and b18).

The two arms (step 16, built 2x) are in a repeat. Each is a hinge-end plate 1x3 plus a clip plate and a long slope. The arm's hinge end (hinge.1) joins the hinge.1 port of the body clip plates b5 and b19 as a hinge/hinge pair (the attach override handles copy 2). This fixes the earlier incompatible hinge-to-clip pairing.

Element ids not in the catalogue were added as new types: 6051038, 6048857, 366026, 428626, 6055063, 4211098, 4516816 and 4278274. 366026 is taken to be an inverted slope 2x2 and 4278274 a round plate 2x2.
The step 19 disc (4278274) is assumed to go under the two socket plates. The step 20 plate 4565322 is assumed to sit on top of the head before the orange crest (4516816) is added.
Instructions end at step 22; the page 16 Cragsters Max combine model is only an advertisement and is not built.
